title: Write the OI class
summary: Write getForward() and getTurn(), then use them in Robot.java.

steps.title: Open OI.java
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `OI` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find it
steps.say: It may be further down. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `write  public static double getForward` and press Enter to jump to it.

waitFor.hint: find write  public static double getForward with Ctrl+F.

steps.title: Open Robot.java
steps.say: Now use it. Press **Ctrl+P**, type `Robot` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find it
steps.say: It may be further down. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `TODO (STEP 1): delete this field` and press Enter to jump to it.

waitFor.hint: find TODO (STEP 1): delete this field with Ctrl+F.

steps.title: Delete this
steps.say: Robot.java shouldn't read the controller anymore. Delete the field, then use `OI.getForward()` and `OI.getTurn()`.
